# Traction

> Open roles at venture-backed startups, read every morning directly from each
> company's own careers page. Free, no account, no recruiters, no paid listings.
> 49,277 open roles at 4,451 funded companies, as of 2026-11-16.

Every figure on this site is a count, never an estimate or a model. Roles come
from the companies' own applicant tracking systems (ashby, bamboohr, breezy, greenhouse, join, lever
and others). A role that is taken down disappears here the next morning.

## Data and reports
- [Observatory](https://tractionjobs.com/observatory/): original counts on startup hiring, free to quote
- [Which ATS startups use](https://tractionjobs.com/observatory/ats-market-share/): share across 4,451 venture-backed companies, rebuilt daily

## Browse
- [All open roles](https://tractionjobs.com/)
- [Companies A-Z](https://tractionjobs.com/startups/): one page per company, with every role it has open
- [By sector](https://tractionjobs.com/sectors/): 16 end markets
- [By investor](https://tractionjobs.com/funds/): roles grouped by the fund that backed the company
- [By role and country](https://tractionjobs.com/pages/)

## About
- [How it works](https://tractionjobs.com/how-it-works/): where the roles come from
- [Contact and corrections](https://tractionjobs.com/mentions/): corrections are made the same day
